200.html:
data

[object]

List of Twilio integration accounts.

attributes [required]

object

Attributes of a Twilio integration account. The Twilio configuration is hoisted directly onto the attributes; there is no interface wrapper because the twilio interface is fixed by the endpoint path.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication methods supported by the Twilio interface. Exactly one is set, selected by its type.

<type=basic>

object

API Key & Secret authentication for Twilio.

api_key [required]

string

Twilio API Key SID for authentication. Create from Twilio Console > Account > API Keys & Tokens.

api_key_token [required]

string

Twilio API Key Secret (token) corresponding to the API Key SID. This field is not returned by the API.

type [required]

enum

Authentication method discriminator. Allowed enum values: basic

default: basic

dataflows

[object]

Dataflows for the Twilio interface.

enabled

boolean

Whether the dataflow is enabled.

id [required]

enum

Identifier of a Twilio dataflow. Allowed enum values: twilio-cloud-cost-metrics,twilio-events-logs,twilio-messages-logs,twilio-alerts-logs,twilio-call-summaries-logs

status

object

Read-only, server-computed collection status of a dataflow.

health

enum

Collection health of a single dataflow. Allowed enum values: DATAFLOW_HEALTH_OK,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_BROKEN,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_UNKNOWN

message

string

Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.

updated_at

date-time

Time the status was last computed.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the account.

permissions

object

Read-only permission information for the account, derived from its restriction policy.

resource_id

string

Restriction-policy resource identifier of this account.

user_can_edit

boolean

Whether the requesting user may edit this account.

settings

object

Twilio interface settings.

account_sid [required]

string

Twilio Account SID that uniquely identifies your Twilio account.

censor_logs

boolean

When enabled, phone numbers in the to field and SMS message bodies are censored for privacy.

id [required]

string

Server-generated unique identifier of the integration account.

type [required]

enum

JSON:API resource type for an integration account. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
